incidents.title: ADNOC L&S Confirms Attack on One Of Its Vessels
incidents.description: ADNOC L&S can confirm that one of its vessels was attacked while transiting the Strait of Hormuz on the evening of 17 November 2026. One crew member remains unaccounted for, with search and rescue operations ongoing in coordination with the relevant authorities. All other crew members have been safely evacuated from the vessel. incidents.title: Smaller Tankers Join Hormuz Shuttle Trade to Keep Oil Flowing
incidents.description: Oil is increasingly moving through the Strait of Hormuz on smaller vessels, helping sustain exports as attacks on supertankers squeeze availability of the ships that typically dominate the trade.

incidents.title: UAE’s ADNOC L&S Says One Crew Member Missing After Attack on Its Vessel in Hormuz
incidents.description: The United Arab Emirates' ADNOC L&S said on Wednesday that one crew member was missing and 11 injured after one of its vessels was attacked in the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday.

incidents.title: LPG Tanker Reported to Have Sunk Off Bulgaria’s Black Sea Coast
incidents.description: A liquefied petroleum gas tanker sank off Bulgaria's Black Sea coast on Tuesday, Bulgaria's defense ministry said, a few dozen miles from where another ship went down after a drone attack a day earlier.
